SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.updated_at, r.status AS run_status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commands c WHERE c.session_id = s.id AND c.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'cancelling')) AS has_active_commands FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.session_id = s.id AND r.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'cancelling') WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (id, project_id, title, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{updatedAt})
